Find an adjustment set

Source: R/identification.R
adjustment_set.Rd

Computes a valid adjustment set for the total causal effect of x on y.

Usage

adjustment_set(cg, x, y, type = c("optimal", "parents", "backdoor"))

Arguments

cg

A DAG, ADMG, PDAG-family (PDAG, CPDAG, MPDAG), AG-family (AG, MAG), or PAG graph created with cgraph().

x, y

Exposure and outcome node name, or character vector of node names (to identify the effect of a set of exposures on a set of outcomes).

type

Adjustment set type: "optimal" (default), "parents", or "backdoor". Ignored for ADMG, MAG-family, and PAG graphs; "backdoor" is not supported for PDAG-family graphs.

Value

Character vector with a valid adjustment set, or NULL if none exists.

Details

The supported adjustment set types depend on the graph class:

DAG

All three types are supported.

PDAG-family (PDAG, CPDAG, MPDAG)

Only "parents" and "optimal" are supported; "backdoor" raises an error.

ADMG, MAG-family (AG, MAG), PAG

type is ignored. The smallest valid adjustment set is returned by searching sets of increasing size.

The available adjustment set types are:

"parents"

The parents of x, excluding x and y.

"backdoor"

An inclusion-minimal set satisfying Pearl's backdoor criterion: a minimal separator of x and y among x's non-descendants, after removing x's outgoing edges (falls back to the parents of x if no such separator is found).

"optimal"

The O-set: the parents of causal nodes on a possibly causal path from x to y, excluding x and those causal nodes themselves.

Candidate adjustment sets can be validated with is_valid_adjustment().

References

Henckel L, Perković E, Maathuis MH (2022). “Graphical Criteria for Efficient Total Effect Estimation Via Adjustment in Causal Linear Models.” Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B, 84, 579–599. ("optimal")

Pearl J (2009). Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference, 2nd edition. Cambridge University Press. ("parents" and "backdoor")

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  dag <- cgraph(
    C %-->% X, X %-->% F + D, A %-->% X + K, K %-->% Y,
    D %-->% Y + G, Y %-->% H
  )
  list(
    parents = sort(adjustment_set(dag, "X", "Y", type = "parents")),
    backdoor = adjustment_set(dag, "X", "Y", type = "backdoor"),
    optimal = adjustment_set(dag, "X", "Y", type = "optimal") # default
  )
}
#> $parents
#> [1] "A" "C"
#> 
#> $backdoor
#> [1] "A"
#> 
#> $optimal
#> [1] "K"
#> 

if (julia_ready()) {
  pdag <- cgraph(A %-->% X, X %-->% Y, A %-->% Y, class = "PDAG")
  list(
    adjustment_set = adjustment_set(pdag, "X", "Y"), # A
    is_valid = is_valid_adjustment(pdag, "X", "Y", "A")
  )
}
#> $adjustment_set
#> [1] "A"
#> 
#> $is_valid
#> [1] TRUE
#> 

if (julia_ready()) {
  mag <- cgraph(A %<->% X, A %-->% Y, X %-->% Y, class = "MAG")
  adjustment_set(mag, "X", "Y") # A; type is ignored
}
#> NULL
